# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

Let me think about this differently. I need a playlist with enough songs to cover 85 minutes (5100 seconds). With average song duration of about 3.5-4 minutes (210-240 seconds), I'd need about 22-25 songs. Let me search for playlists with more songs.

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

day: monday
exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

exercises:

- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:

- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:

- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

exercises:

- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

day: monday
exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

exercises:

- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

exercises:

- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

exercises:

- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

day: monday
exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

exercises:

- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:

- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes

- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

exercises:

- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

exercises:

- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

exercises:

exercises:

duration_mins: 85

exercises:

duration_mins: 90

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:

- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:

- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:

duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:

- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

day: monday
exercises:

duration_mins: 30

exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

exercises:

- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

exercises:

- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- 'Morning meditation: 10 minutes of mindfulness'
- Full-body dynamic stretches - 5 minutes
- Kettlebell swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Renegade rows - 3 sets of 10 reps per arm
- Plyometric box jumps - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing
duration_mins: 30

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- Rock climbing - 1 hour at a local indoor climbing gym
- TRX suspension training - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Handstand practice - 10 minutes against a wall
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 85

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Morning yoga session - 30 minutes of vinyasa flow
- Biking - 45 minutes of cycling in a hilly terrain
- Medicine ball slams - 4 sets of 20 seconds
- Bosu ball squats - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep stretches
duration_mins: 90

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- CrossFit-style AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) - 20 minutes
- Barbell deadlifts - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Hanging leg raises - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of foam rolling
duration_mins: 60

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Swimming drills - 30 minutes focusing on different strokes
- Resistance band pull-aparts - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Sprints - 10 sets of 100 meters
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 70

day: saturday
exercises:
- Morning Tai Chi session - 40 minutes of fluid movements
- Parkour practice - 30 minutes of jumping, climbing, and balancing
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 80

day: sunday
exercises:
- Active recovery - 1-hour leisurely bike ride or stroll
- Yoga for relaxation - 30 minutes of gentle poses and meditation
duration_mins: 90
